quests.instruction: What is the name for the strip that can be stretchy elastic or a stiffer strip with a button? It is also the snug strip of fabric that circles the very top of our pants, but it is NOT your sleeve!
quests.question: Waistband
quests.hint: Hint: Belt loops are sewn onto this part.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Waistband is the snug strip of fabric at the top of pants, around your waist!
quests.funFact: Some waistbands are stretchy elastic, perfect for growing kids.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is knotted neatly just below our collar, but it is not your gloves. What is it?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: It is knotted around your collar.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Ties come in every color, pattern, and even shape you can imagine.

quests.instruction: We wear this when we go outside on a cool morning. It is NOT your jeans. What is it?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You put this on over your shirt!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Jackets keep the cold wind out so we stay cozy!

quests.instruction: We wear this to keep the warm sun out of our eyes. It is NOT your cap. What is it?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It sits right on top of your head!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Hats block the hot sun from our eyes!

quests.instruction: We wear this on a hot day when we want to splash and float, but it is not your wetsuit. What is it?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: It is made to get wet and dry fast.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: The very first swimsuits were made of wool, which got very heavy when wet.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the set of clothes we choose each morning before we start our day? It is also all the clothes we put on together for one day, but it is NOT your tights!
quests.question: Outfit
quests.hint: Hint: You choose this every morning before school.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Outfit is the name for the whole set of clothes you wear together!
quests.funFact: An outfit can be simple and comfy, or fancy for a special day.

quests.instruction: We wear this when we splash through puddles or trudge through snow. It is NOT your sandals. What is it?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover more of your leg than regular shoes!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Boots reach higher up your leg than regular shoes do!

quests.instruction: We wear this on a gray, drizzly, splashy-puddle kind of day, but it is not your windbreaker. What is it?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: It often has a hood.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Many raincoats have a hood attached to keep your hair dry too.

quests.instruction: We wear this so our trousers do not slip down while we play, but it is not your windbreaker. What is it?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: It threads through little loops on your pants.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: Belts can be made of leather, cloth, or even stretchy elastic.

quests.instruction: We wear this to protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground. It is NOT your boots. What is it?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your feet before you go outside!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Shoes protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground!

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of our regular clothes, just for pretend play. It is also worn for a fun dress-up party or a school play, but it is NOT your uniform. What is it?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: You wear this to pretend to be someone else!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: A costume can turn you into a superhero, a dragon, or anything you imagine!

quests.instruction: We wear this to a birthday party to look extra special. It is NOT your socks. What is it?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is one piece that covers your whole body!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: A dress is one single piece of clothing, not two separate parts!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a long tie, for a fun, fancy look, not your belt. What is it?
quests.question: Bow Tie
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Magicians sometimes wear these.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: Magicians and waiters often wear a smart bow tie at work.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is soft, loose, and comfortable for sleeping. It is NOT your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear these to bed!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Pajamas are made extra soft and loose so you can sleep comfortably!

quests.instruction: We wear this that has two dark lenses and two little arms, but it is not your mittens. What is it?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: They have two dark lenses.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Good sunglasses also help block harmful rays from the sun.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our backpack to keep it dry in a sudden rainstorm. It is also worn shaped like a simple square with a hole for our head, but it is NOT your raincoat. What is it?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: It has a hole for your head, and that's it!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: A poncho is just one simple piece with a hole cut for your head!

quests.instruction: We wear this with a small pocket, just the right size for a coin. It is also worn instead of soft cotton pants, for extra-tough play, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: They are usually a deep blue color!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Jeans are made from a strong, sturdy fabric called denim!

quests.instruction: We wear this that snaps together at the bottom, all in one comfy piece. It is also worn instead of separate pajama pieces, for cozy one-piece sleeping, but it is NOT your wetsuit. What is it?
quests.question: Onesie
quests.hint: Think about this: It often snaps closed underneath.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: Some onesies are shaped like a favorite animal, with ears and a tail.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the tube-shaped part of a shirt that covers our arm? It is also the part of a jacket our hand pokes out of at the end, but it is NOT your collar!
quests.question: Sleeve
quests.hint: Think about this: It covers your arm, not your body.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: You can roll a sleeve up when your arm starts to feel too warm.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this instead of a hat, when only our ears feel cold, not your beanie. What is it?
quests.question: Earmuffs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A padded band connects the two sides.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: Some earmuffs fold flat so they are easy to carry in a bag.

quests.instruction: We wear this that fits snugly over our whole body for surfing in cold ocean water. It is also worn before we go surfing, diving, or swimming in a chilly sea, but it is NOT your bathrobe. What is it?
quests.question: Wetsuit
quests.hint: Think about this: It is made of thick, stretchy rubber.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: Surfers and divers wear wetsuits to stay warm in cold ocean water.

quests.instruction: We wear this that covers our ears completely on a freezing day. It is also worn instead of a cap, when we want our whole head warm, but it is NOT your helmet. What is it?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: It has no brim at all!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: A beanie has no brim, so it hugs your whole head snugly!

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this on a very hot day, to keep our arms totally cool, not your hoodie. What is it?
quests.question: Tank Top
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You might wear this under a jacket in summer.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: Athletes often wear tank tops so their arms can move freely.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of sneakers on a wet, rainy, puddly day. It is also worn when we jump and splash in puddles after a storm, but it is NOT your flip-flops. What is it?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: They are made of waterproof rubber!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Rain boots are made of rubber, so water cannot soak through them!

quests.instruction: We wear this to protect our shirt from flour, paint, or splashes. It is also worn in the kitchen, right before we start cooking dinner, but it is NOT your gloves. What is it?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: You wear this over your clothes while cooking or painting!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: An apron catches spills and splatters before they reach your clothes!

quests.instruction: We wear this that swishes and rustles a little as we move. It is also worn on a breezy day when we do not want to feel chilly, but it is NOT your raincoat. What is it?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: It is thin, but it still blocks the wind!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: A windbreaker is thin, but it still keeps gusty wind off your skin!

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of picking our own clothes, for school or a team. It is also worn so a whole soccer team looks matching during a game, but it is NOT your life jacket. What is it?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Everyone on the same team or school wears the same one!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: A uniform shows everyone which team or school you belong to!

quests.instruction: We wear this that buttons up the front but leaves our arms bare, but it is not your tank top. What is it?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: It covers your chest and back, but your arms are free.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: Some vests are worn for fancy outfits, and some for safety at work.

quests.instruction: We wear this to keep our feet cozy while we walk on cold floors, but it is not your jeans. What is it?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: You slide these on easily, with no laces.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: You can slide slippers on and off in just a second, with no laces.

quests.instruction: We wear this under our pajamas too, every night before bed, but it is not your poncho. What is it?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: You change into a fresh, clean pair every day.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Changing into clean underwear every day helps you stay fresh and healthy.
